description: Valid and invalid controls manifests (controls.schema.json), run against both validators: note-model.mjs and notes_bridge.py's problems().

valid.why: one control of every type, one scoped to a variant
a motion easing as a select of named curves

invalid.why: a type the registry does not have
a built-in type a page may not write
a target that is neither a CSS variable nor a data-control attribute
a target that is a CSS declaration
a variant key with a space
a unit that is not a CSS unit word
an unknown field on a control
